Name: Costar
Effect: If there's an allied Pokémon with increased Attributes/Traits as this Pokémon enters the field, copy all of the Increases onto this Pokémon. If more than one allied Pokémon has increased Attributes/Traits, choose one to copy from.
Description: This Pokémon is a true pal, friend, and wingman. It will follow you on any crazy plan you concoct. The player-2 of your dynamic duo.
